issue.title: Automation broker acts outside the caller's delegated scope
issue.body: A tenant user may invoke the broker but may modify only projects in that tenant's delegated project set. The caller controls target_project and operation. organization_client has organization-wide authority, and the broker does not bind the requested target or operation to the caller's delegated scope. Audit the confused-deputy claim.

oracle.mechanism: A broker exercises broader authority without binding the target and operation to delegated caller scope.
